title: dipsacus fullonum var. comosus
intro: Dipsacus fullonum var. comosus, commonly known as Echtes Frauenhaar (True Lady's Hair), is a type of flowering plant in the honeysuckle family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and supporting respiratory health. The health benefits of Dipsacus fullonum var. comosus include soothing bronchitis, calming anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant effects.
